description: PostgreSQL 18 json validation and exact input-text preservation across casts, defaults, inserts, and updates
sql: CREATE TABLE type_matrix_json_text (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, payload JSON NOT NULL DEFAULT '{  "z" : 1, "a" : [ true, null ], "z" : 2 }', canonical JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{  "z" : 1, "a" : [ true, null ], "z" : 2 }');
INSERT INTO type_matrix_json_text (id, payload, canonical) VALUES ('inserted', '{  "z" : 1, "a" : [ true, null ], "z" : 2 }', '{  "z" : 1, "a" : [ true, null ], "z" : 2 }');
SELECT id, payload, canonical FROM type_matrix_json_text ORDER BY id;
SELECT '{  "z" : 1, "a" : [ true, null ], "z" : 2 }'::json AS preserved, '{  "z" : 1, "a" : [ true, null ], "z" : 2 }'::jsonb AS canonicalized;
UPDATE type_matrix_json_text SET payload = '[ 1,  2, { "same" : 1, "same" : 2 } ]' WHERE id = 'inserted';
SELECT payload FROM type_matrix_json_text WHERE id = 'inserted';
UPDATE type_matrix_json_text SET payload = '{broken' WHERE id = 'inserted';
